title: AI-Native Security: Building a Proactive Defense System in the AI Era
description: For years, the software security process has usually relied on a fairly familiar model: developers write code, the CI/CD system runs security scanning tools, the security team assesses the results…
flags: §1: 'chiến dịch công bố các lỗ hổng PHP' rendered as 'a coordinated disclosure campaign for PHP vulnerabilities' — the source implies a coordinated vendor disclosure rather than a plain announcement.
§2.2 heading: 'Có quá nhiều cảnh báo nhưng không biết xử lý theo thứ tự nào' rendered as 'Plenty of alerts, but no idea what order to handle them in'.
§7 subheading: 'Security context dành cho AI coding agent' rendered as 'Security context for AI coding agents' (pluralized for natural English).
§11 'lỗi SSRF' kept as 'SSRF bug'; 'mẫu phân quyền an toàn' rendered as 'safe authorization pattern'.
